name: Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA)
description: A 30-point, 10-minute cognitive screening tool assessing attention, concentration, executive functions, memory, language, visuoconstructional skills, and orientation. Free for clinical/educational use.
reputation: Validated in 35+ languages; free download for healthcare providers; widely used for dementia/MCI screening.
notes: Ceiling effects in highly educated populations; copyright now enforced for commercial use.
